 "rationale": "Two stages give about 70 dB: about 37 dB with L=0.5 in and L=1 load, plus about 33 dB. GBW=gm1/2πCc: gm1 is about 0.5 mS with Cc=1 pF, giving about 80 MHz. gm6 of about 2.7 mS puts p2 above 100 MHz, and Rz moves the zero into the LHP. Current: 10 uA ref + 67 uA tail + 250 uA output = 327 uA, about 590 uW. SR=min(67 V/us, 83 V/us). The CS output swings rail-to-rail minus two Vdsat, about 1.3 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair efficiency
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (67e-6, 40e-6, 110e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmidL": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "LL":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror load L
    "I6":    (250e-6, 150e-6, 300e-6),  # output stage current
    "gmid6": (11.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # output PMOS gm/Id
    "L6":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # output PMOS L
    "Ln":    (0.6, 0.4, 1.5),        # NMOS current-source L (bias, tail, sink)
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 1.6e-12),
    "kz":    (1.6, 0.8, 3.5),        # Rz = kz / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]; I1 = It / 2.0; I6 = p["I6"]; Cc = p["Cc"]
    gmid_n = 8.0

    # bias reference (diode) and NMOS current sources: same L and gm/Id
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    vb = mb.vgs
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.33)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # input pair (source ~0.33 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.4, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidL"], p["LL"], I1, vds=1.1)
    # output PMOS common source
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm3, gm6 = m1.gm, m3.gm, m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # input pair: vinn on diode side, vinp on the output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "nd", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 0.5 * m3.cgg * 0
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    pm_mirror = gm3 / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd) / (2 * PI)
    # zero: 1/(Cc(1/gm6 - Rz)) -> LHP when Rz > 1/gm6
    denom = (1.0 / gm6 - Rz)
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * denom)
    ph_z = math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / abs(fz)))
    ph_z = ph_z if fz < 0 else -ph_z            # LHP zero adds phase
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) + ph_z
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I6)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "swing": swing,
               "power": power, "slew": slew}
